title: Lindy alternatives: AI agent tools compared | 50agents
description: Lindy alternatives: Gumloop for team AI agents, Relevance AI for sales, Zapier Agents, n8n to self-host, and 50agents for AI agents plus apps and automations.
answer: Gumloop builds shared team AI agents and Relevance AI builds sales AI agent teams.
n8n self-hosts; 50agents adds apps and automations to AI agents, free to start.
ask: Set up an AI agent that reads new support emails, drafts a reply from what you know about my business, and asks me before sending
lede: AI agent tools like Lindy, and how each one differs.

strengths.title: AI agents that decide
strengths.line: Each run, an AI agent works from your instructions and connected apps.

strengths.title: It knows your business
strengths.line: Hours, prices, policies and tone, remembered once and used in every reply.

strengths.title: You approve what goes out
strengths.line: Emails to clients wait in Needs you until you say yes.

strengths.title: Apps with your own records
strengths.line: Lists, boards and tables, run by a crew of AI agents.

move.title: List what Lindy does
move.body: Write down each task: which inbox, which calendar, what it drafts.

move.title: Tell Captain the first task
move.body: Say it in one sentence, like "draft replies to new support emails".

move.title: Teach it your business
move.body: Add your hours, prices and policies once; replies draw on them.

move.title: Approve the first drafts
move.body: Every reply waits in Needs you until you approve it.

faqs.q: Is there a free Lindy alternative?
faqs.a: Lindy starts with $50 in credits for 7 days. 50agents is free to start, and n8n has a self-hosted version on GitHub.

faqs.q: Do these alternatives ask before acting?
faqs.a: Gumloop gates tool calls until you approve, and Relevance AI has approval steps. In 50agents, anything that reaches someone outside waits for your yes.

faqs.q: Which works with the most apps?
faqs.a: Zapier connects 10,541+ apps. Lindy lists 2,733 plus MCP servers, and 50agents works with 2,300+ through viaSocket.
